description: The radar's own fault flag (0x196 byte 1 bit 0) across comma's public fleet logs of Toyota radar-ACC cars with bus 1 (RAV4 2022 / 2023, C-HR, Yaris): when it is set, for how long, and what the radar does meanwhile. Devices anonymised (F1-F4); exploratory, bus-output authority (what the radar publishes, not what it senses).

blocked_minutes.object_list: keeps running at the full record rate with valid CRC; long-lived tracks out to 170-246 m; no slot or header field separates the minutes from same-device controls

rule: flag set on >= 2 consecutive cycles: radarUnavailableTemporary; first clear cycle clears it; reaction 0.06 s after the radar raises it
